name: sliding floor pulldown on towel v. 2
description: A prone floor pulldown with the hands sliding on towels from overhead toward the ribs, training the lats without weights.
instructions: Lie face down on a smooth floor with a small towel under each hand and your arms extended overhead.
Keep your neck neutral and lift your chest only slightly if comfortable.
Slide your hands toward your ribs by driving your elbows down and back, squeezing your lats.
Reach your arms forward along the floor again with control.
